reviewsList.author: Sanaa M.
reviewsList.comment: Waw wallahila top! Hair becomes super soft without feeling oily or heavy. My curls look bouncy and defined all day long. Delivery in Casablanca was under 24 hours!

reviewsList.author: Houda B.
reviewsList.comment: The combination of Cactus Oil & Aloe Vera is brilliant. I used to suffer from extreme humidity frizz in Rabat, but 3 pumps of this mousse completely fixed it. Will definitely reorder the 3 bottle bundle!

reviewsList.author: Yasmine K.
reviewsList.comment: Zero crunchy feeling! I hate old traditional mousses that make hair hard like wire. This one is like a hydrating cloud. Smell is so refreshing and natural.

reviewsList.author: Khadija T.
reviewsList.comment: Super fast Cash on Delivery in Agadir. Packaging is high quality and the foam dispenser pumps smoothly. Hair feels silky immediately.

reviewsList.author: Meriem L.
reviewsList.comment: Very good product for daily use. I use 2 pumps every morning after shower. Keeps flyaways tame all day. Highly recommended!
